giver: Miners' guild: toolsmith and armourer representatives in every village; the Guildmaster in Reece for key moments
feel: Mining rescues: cave-ins, lost miners and deep expeditions, each deeper than the last

quests.title: The Guild Card
quests.summary: A village toolsmith signs you into the Miners' Guild if you can prove you'll swing a pick: bring 32 cobblestone, 16 coal and a stone pickaxe you made yourself.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a guild lantern and a stamped guild card

quests.title: First Shift
quests.summary: Your first paid shift: 24 raw copper and 16 coal from the shallow seams the guild leases near the village, mined before nightfall.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a stack of torches

quests.title: The Canary Stopped Singing
quests.summary: A small collapse traps an apprentice in a hillside tunnel near the village; dig through the gravel fall without bringing the rest down and lead him out alive.
quests.reward: Mining XP, the apprentice's spare iron pickaxe

quests.title: Shoring Up
quests.summary: After the scare the guild drills its crews in safety: craft ladders, scaffolding and 64 torches, and shore up the practice shaft with log props every few blocks.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a rope coil and a safety net

quests.title: The Old Workings
quests.summary: Find any old mineshaft (YUNG's Better Mineshafts) and recover a lantern and a rail from its deepest gallery: the guild is mapping every abandoned working before someone falls into one.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a guild map case

quests.title: The Iron Seam
quests.summary: The guild's smiths need metal: mine 48 raw iron, smelt it, and forge a full set of iron tools for the next rescue crew.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a blast furnace

quests.title: Lights Out
quests.summary: Every torch in a YUNG's mineshaft has gone out and a surveyor is somewhere inside; follow his tapping and the glow lichen he scraped onto the walls to find him in the pitch dark. He presses his spare goggles on you.
quests.reward: Mining XP, Night Vision Goggles

quests.title: Vein Breaker
quests.summary: The guild foreman shows you the vein-miner's knack (FTB Ultimine): break a whole coal or iron vein in one go, then clear a 64-block side tunnel the same way.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a crate of food for long swings

quests.title: Alpine Prospect
quests.summary: A prospector's letter speaks of ore in the high peaks: climb the tallest mountains (Tectonic) and mine alpine iron ore, alpine copper ore and a lump of alpine salt.
quests.reward: Mining XP, climbing rope from the prospector

quests.title: Supplies for the Camp
quests.summary: A mining camp out in the wilds is short of everything: deliver 32 bread, 64 torches and 8 iron pickaxes to the miners at a mine with campsite or a badlands miner outpost.
quests.reward: Mining XP, the camp boss's mining helmet lamp (a lantern) and a tip about a lost crew

quests.title: The Depth Chart
quests.summary: Fill the guild's depth chart: redstone and lapis from below Y 0, gold from the badlands surface, copper from the dripstone caves, each tagged with the depth you mined it at.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a guild compass engraved with the depths

quests.title: The Underminer
quests.summary: Miners talk of a ghostly figure that digs beside you in the deep and vanishes. Find the Underminer (Alex's Mobs) in a cave and follow it: it leads you to a sealed side passage full of ore.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a cache of raw gold

quests.title: The Lost Crew
quests.summary: The camp's survey crew went down a Dungeons Arise mining system three days ago and never came up. Fight through the infested galleries, find the three miners and get them to the lifts.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a diamond pickaxe from the crew's foreman

quests.title: Into the Deepslate
quests.summary: The guild's next shaft goes below Y -32: mine down into the deepslate for 8 deepslate diamond ore (with Silk Touch or as diamonds) and 64 cobbled deepslate for the shaft walls.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a deepslate guild badge

quests.title: The Shift Meal
quests.summary: The guild cook feeds the rescue crews before the big descent: grow or forage onions, then cook onion soup and pasta with onion sauce for a crew of six and serve it at the shaft head.
quests.reward: Mining XP, the cook's Onion Ring

quests.title: Cave-In
quests.summary: The new deep shaft collapses with you and two miners behind the fall, and your pick is under the rubble: dig the tunnel open with a shovel and bare hands before the air runs out (a timed challenge). The old miner who survived gives you his claws.
quests.reward: Mining XP, Digging Claws

quests.title: Three Famous Seams
quests.summary: An old prospector swears his scarf brings luck. Bet him you can bring emerald from the high peaks, gold from a mesa mineshaft and diamond from the deepslate before he finishes his pipe; win, and the scarf is yours.
quests.reward: Mining XP, Lucky Scarf

quests.title: The Spore Shaft
quests.summary: Miners working the Dungeons Arise mushroom mines have gone strange from the spores; escort four of them back to the surface through the overgrown tunnels, keeping them away from the glowing caps.
quests.reward: Mining XP, mushroom stew and a stack of glowshrooms

quests.title: Fire Below
quests.summary: A fire has broken out in the scorched mines and the trapped miners are holding a gallery against what crawled out of the burning seams; reach them with fire resistance potions and water buckets and hold until they're out.
quests.reward: Mining XP, fire resistance potions

quests.title: The Surveyor's Glass
quests.summary: The guild surveyor wants to read the deep rock: crack open an amethyst geode, bring 16 amethyst shards and 8 copper ingots, and craft her a spyglass and a tinted glass lamp.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a spyglass of your own

quests.title: Strange Minerals
quests.summary: Rumours of strange stone deep under the world: dig samples of amber from the Primordial Caves, guanostone from the Forlorn Hollows and abyssmarine from the Abyssal Chasm (Alex's Caves; the caves' own questline goes deeper).
quests.reward: Mining XP, a guild note pointing to the caves' own questline

quests.title: The Lost Expedition's Journal
quests.summary: A guild expedition went too deep and found an ancient city; one survivor made it out without the expedition journal. Creep through the sculk without waking the Warden and bring the journal back from beside the portal frame.
quests.reward: Mining XP, swift sneak book and the journal's ore map

quests.title: The Cold Forge
quests.summary: The guild's deep forge below Y -50 has gone cold and no one can smelt down there. Carry a stack of coal blocks, 16 blaze powder and magma blocks down to relight it; the smith fits your pick with a heater in thanks.
quests.reward: Mining XP, Pickaxe Heater

quests.title: Ancient Debris
quests.summary: The guild has never had netherite. Find and mine 8 ancient debris near Nether lava level, blasting or digging.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a netherite upgrade template

quests.title: The Quartz Contract
quests.summary: A guild contract for the Nether: 64 nether quartz, 32 gold nuggets from nether gold ore and 16 gilded blackstone, mined in one trip and sold through the guild.
quests.reward: Mining XP, emeralds and a guild contract seal

quests.title: Netherite Pick
quests.summary: Smelt your debris to netherite scrap, alloy an ingot, and upgrade your diamond pickaxe at a smithing table: the first netherite pick the guild has seen.
quests.reward: Mining XP, the guild's respect (rank: Deep Delver)

quests.title: Cutting Obsidian
quests.summary: For the memorial and the guild's new deep doors: 64 obsidian and 16 crying obsidian, cut cleanly (vein-mine the slab if you can).
quests.reward: Mining XP, a stack of deepslate tiles

quests.title: The Great Collapse
quests.summary: The deepest rescue: the old mine under Reece gives way at Y -58 with seven miners below. Reach each pocket of survivors through deepslate, lava and falling gravel, and bring them all up before the last torch burns down.
quests.reward: Mining XP, every miner's thanks and a diamond block

quests.title: The Miners' Memorial
quests.summary: Build the guild a memorial at the guildhall in Reece: polished deepslate, obsidian, lanterns and a sign for every miner lost or saved on your rescues.
quests.reward: Mining XP, the memorial plaque named for you

quests.title: The Mother Lode
quests.summary: A guildmaster's test: bring a block of every metal and gem the guild works (coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, emerald, diamond and netherite).
quests.reward: Mining XP, a deep miner's beacon

quests.title: Lifeline
quests.summary: The Guildmaster in Reece names you Master of Rescues and hands over the guild's oldest pick, reforged.
quests.reward: Mining XP, Lifeline (named netherite pickaxe: Efficiency V, Fortune III, Unbreaking III, Mending)
